summary: As of 2026-10-01, First Brands Group is adjudged ADVERSE (95% confidence) because it entered Chapter 7 bankruptcy liquidation on 2026-09-01, as shown by its Wikipedia entry and corroborated by press releases and news reports.

findings.statement: First Brands Group entered Chapter 7 bankruptcy liquidation as of September 1, 2026.
First Brands Group initiated voluntary U.S. Chapter 11 bankruptcy cases in a press release dated September 28, 2025.
First Brands Group is a global supplier of automotive aftermarket parts.
First Brands Group was founded in 2013 in Ohio under the legal name Crowne Group.
First Brands Group's headquarters is located in Cleveland, Ohio, United States.
